thread:
jess: Quick heads-up — I opened PR #3124 to tighten up how we return statuses for routing/quota vs transient capacity. TL;DR: standardize on 429 for quota/rate, 503 for transient overload, include Retry-After when retryable, and add an error_class header for telemetry.

miguel: thanks. can you link the PR? curious how this plays with Dedicated vs Hosted quotas — we currently mix signals.

jess: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3124 — PR has examples and a migration section. key part is we emit X-Redwood-Error-Class: quota|overload|auth and X-Redwood-Route-Policy: primary|fallback when relevant.

erica: +1 for explicit error_class. SDKs should map quota->Retryable=false? I think quota is retryable only after the window. we should expose a boolean header too: X-Redwood-Retryable: true|false.

miguel: agree. and ensure Retry-After is always seconds and present when Retryable=true. example:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
X-Redwood-Error-Class: quota
X-Redwood-Retryable: true
```

navin: one concern: we currently return 503 for some owner-side throttles to trigger fallback routing (so the router rejects and tries next model variant). If we map 503 strictly to overload, router behavior might change. we need a router-compatible header like X-Redwood-Fallback: route-v2.

jess: good catch. PR adds X-Redwood-Action: fallback|fail|escalate so router can decide deterministically. default mapping: quota -> fail (no fallback), overload -> fallback, auth -> fail.

sam: UX question: in Console should we surface server-side "503 overload" as "temporarily unavailable — retry in Xs" vs "quota exceeded" mapped to plan upsell language? product wants friendly copy for quota errors to suggest plan/contacts.

anna: product note — we should avoid exposing internal metrics but show actionable guidance. propose mapping table in console: quota -> "You've hit your plan limits. See upgrade options or contact support.", overload -> "Service is experiencing heavy load. Please retry in a few seconds.". Also add a small tooltip that links to docs.

miguel: telemetry-wise we need: error_class, route_policy, action, retry_after_seconds, fallback_triggered boolean, and anonymized customer_tier. then dash of p50/p95 Retry-After and fallback success rate.

erica: add a span tag for whether the SDK automatically retried or surfaced to user. we need to track "sdk_handled=true" vs false. helps tie console messages to SDK behavior.

sam: small consider — internationalization. console messages should be keys (client_visible_key) and we localize. don't store raw copy in telemetry, store the key.

anna: agreed. telemetry field: client_visible_key: quota_exceeded_plan_limit; console resolves key -> copy. keeps telemetry smaller and GDPR-safer.

miguel: rollout plan suggestion: 1) land headers + telemetry in canary backend (1% traffic) for 48h, 2) update router to honor X-Redwood-Action, 3) update SDKs to respect X-Redwood-Retryable and Retry-After, 4) enable Console mapping for internal orgs, 5) expand to 25% then 100% after 2-week monitoring window.

jess: sounds good. I'll update PR with the rollout steps. also added a migration script for internal consumers to map old 503->quota cases.

navin: tests required: router unit tests for Action header, e2e with fallback model, telemetry ingestion test (error_class buckets), and SDK retry simulator. add an opt-in flag for dedicated customers that want legacy behavior for 30 days.

erica: one more — add an opt-out for console messages (some enterprises require no plan hints). header: X-Redwood-Client-Visibility: public|private. default public.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Deployed PR #3124 to canary (1%). Canaries: eng-platform-internal only. Observability: added dashboard 'error-class-rollout' with counts and Retry-After histogram.

miguel: watching dashboard. initial traffic shows a lot of 429s for a small org — we might need clearer per-route quotas or client guidance. I'll annotate the dashboard with top offending routes.

jess: next steps — I'll open a short doc for SDK change requirements, ping devex for example messages, and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to confirm roll timing. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
